company.name: Mother Computer
company.shortDescription: Mother Computer develops local AI hardware and software systems for running open-source artificial intelligence models on-device.
company.description: Mother Computer develops local artificial intelligence hardware and software systems that run open-source models directly on user devices. The company focuses on decentralized and private AI by tightly integrating a proprietary software stack with specialized computing hardware. Its flagship product, Mother I, is an AI supercomputer designed to train, serve, and orchestrate a wide range of open-source AI models locally. The supporting software stack handles training, high-speed inference, and multi-agent workflows without reliance on external cloud infrastructure. Mother Computer targets developers, creators, and organizations that require high-performance AI capabilities with direct control over models and data. Its offerings are positioned for use cases that benefit from local processing, including experimentation with open-source models, autonomous agents, and low-latency AI applications.
